notes.title: Win SCP-049 DLC!
notes.notes:
Win a SCP-049 DLC key by joining our Photoshop Battle!

Researchers, by now you've heard that SCP-049 is suspected to be active in ███. Reports of anomalous activity like ███ and ███ abound.

Where will SCP-049 be sighted next? What will be the consequences of his "research"? What exactly is his "cure"? Use your Photoshop skills to show us, and you could win a DLC key!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/22b33113f9555d79032437c0e6dd6b2ad97fc3af.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nominate SCP: Secret Files for Labor of Love in the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Please nominate SCP: Secret Files for "Labor of Love" in the 2022 Steam Awards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/44aba71ff961fe71b8fe91e1b8d5672c70206e02.png[/img]

The SCP universe is vast and varied, and it never fails to fill us with awe. 

We set out to share that awe with other passionate players like us: Those enthralled by a world filled with the unexplained. Yes, sometimes it fills us with dread; but other times, it surprises us, makes us laugh, and even warms our hearts.

It was incredibly challenging to convey such a wide variety of themes and tones, from comedy to horror. It flexed our every creative muscle, but your responses have been truly gratifying:


"Forget every SCP game you've played so far. This one is by far the highest quality ever made.... It's a real masterpiece." 

“Brilliant, exquisite, astonishing.... You guys went the scenic route, to show that SCP is not just scary and horror stuff. It's everything and nothing. The stories, the possibilities -- they're endless."

"This form of storytelling is the definitive way SCP stories can be brought to life in such an epic and immersive way." 

We'd be truly honored if you'd vote for us as a Labor of Love in this year's Steam Awards! We hope the love we've poured into Secret Files is evident to you, and would love to share it with more gamers. 

We humbly thank you for your consideration! Remember you can always connect with us on [url=discord.gg/GpUeSgMJMA]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/files_scp]Twitter[/url].

Stay sane, and stay in awe!

notes.title: November Devlog | DLC and Digital Art Book Update!
notes.notes:
Long time no see, Researchers. GameZoo here!

It's been a little over a month since SCP: Secret Files launched on Steam! We've received a humbling amount of praise and encouragement in that time. Ever since our studio was founded-- no, ever since the concept for Secret Files first took root in our brains!-- we've dreamed of nothing more than bringing this game to life. Indie studios always risk their road collapsing while they're in the middle of building it, and we truly could not have completed this journey without your support. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you!

Since launch, we have slowed down on public dev updates, but have no fear: we've had our heads down following up on those tasty breadcrumbs we left you in the game ([i][b]049 DLC[/b][/i], the main story follow up on 055, etc). By popular request, the digital concept art book is also underway!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/53660bc545ebeb50a480382565183a508d3b3055.png[/img]

Speaking of DLC... The story will unfold with a unique perspective and atmosphere. We will stick to our creative vision: rejecting monotony, telling a different and fun story, and injecting some surprising gameplay (how about that gunplay you've all been asking about?). 049 is such a special entity -- he has power, elegance, and intellect; he embodies benevolence and malevolence in one form. You can't help but be drawn in by this "plague doctor" and his mysterious background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/77330ffb494ccbe72db599d6bd92b7237fcbc692.jpg[/img]
[b][i]DLC Character Art[/i][/b]

To create a story exclusively for him, we repeatedly redrafted and remodeled, polished and polished again, moving step-by-step closer to 049's dark yet fervent world. Finally, after much heated discussion, we've settled on our current rendering as ███.

Now we are in full swing to bring this idea to fruition. We sincerely hope that, by providing a unique, grounded narrative gaming experience, we can pass along this spark in our hearts to all of you other passionate fans of the Foundation and 049.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/5da4b7ff0ebbbd06790a8070a73f44ec61ec6fd4.jpg[/img]
[b][i]DLC Concept Art   [/i][/b] 

Right now, we're feeling great. Maybe the GZ-6 will become the GZ-8? It's looking like the SCP mega-series of our dreams may actually be possible! Of course, we can't hope to cover the whole SCP universe. After all, the wiki updates hundreds of times per day... No matter how fast we work, we'd still be left in the dust. For now, we're focused on the stories with strong narrative qualities, that jive with our main storyline, and that are most beloved by the community! So much to do, with so little time-- but that's life at the Foundation. 

We'll leave off here for now, since we've got bugs to hunt. Wish you all good health. And eat well: It puts you in the right mind to operate!


[b]We fight in the dark, so that you may live in the light.[/b]

It is inevitable that you will have uncovered some interesting "news" related to Foundation anomalies while dealing with the secret files. For example, [i]could the Guatemalan sinkhole be related to SCP-994? What about the mysterious corpse found in the forest northwest of Yekaterinburg? [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/b560e503acd2bec1a0c6f62ad7e6e1eb283b41a8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: SCP: Secret Files Has Officially Launched!
notes.notes:
[i]Alright rookies, listen up...[/i]

[i]You've made it this far, so welcome to The Foundation. The secret files have been declassified, and you now have access to information that would make your average Joe's head explode. But not so fast, rookies. Wipe that smile off your face, because not everyone makes it through induction in one piece...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/75bcc61ae07de907d50a0465bea5e63d67cd8bbc.png[/img]

After several years of development and the unbreakable determination of our humble dev team
[b] SCP: Secret Files has finally been released! [/b]

We're SCP fans, first and foremost, and we've poured all our energies into creating the type of SCP game we've dreamed of playing ourselves. We hope our commitment to honor the essence of SCP mythology shines through, and for those who have never heard of SCP before - maybe our game can serve as an introduction to the wonderful SCP wiki.

Thanks to all who have supported us on our journey, offered feedback, and motivated us to do better. We will continue to improve the experience, and we hope you enjoy what we've created.

[i]We fight in the dark so that you can live in the light.[/i]

Watch our trailer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1xaxCB-qV6I&t=1s]here[/url].

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/files_scp]Twitter[/url]
Join our [url=discord.gg/GpUeSgMJMA]Discord[/url]

notes.title: 07/22 Devlog: Fellow researchers, please be prepared!
notes.notes:
An unexpected rainstorm near our studio recently brought heatwave temperatures back down towards normality, and we suddenly realised it had been over a month since our last proper update!

I guess we did disappear for a while. On the one hand, wishlists for SCP: Secret files have risen to over 180,000, far exceeding our expectations. We are very honored to have so many players supporting our work, but this level of trust and expectation also places more responsibility on our shoulders and makes us more focused and cautious. On the other hand, we are constantly collecting and absorbing feedback from both players and the media as we try our best to improve many aspects of the game.

Like all members of the SCP Foundation, we are willing to work silently in the dark to create a better and more vibrant world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/199dfd7859b38cb38ccd24000765818a62af2572.png[/img]

However, perhaps due to the gameplay style showcased in our Steam Next Fest demo, or maybe because the most popular SCP games tend to lean heavily on horror, we have discovered that a considerable number of players believe that SCP: Secret Files will be a 100% horror-focused game.

Allow us to clear up any confusion - horror is simply one element of the SCP: Secret Files experience.

Unlike some other SCP games that focus on a specific gameplay style (such as first-person shooter, survival horror, etc), our aim was to bring SCP stories to life in a more diverse way based on our understanding of SCP fiction and mythology. Of the various anomalies depicted in our game, some will be benign or even friendly, while others are grotesque and highly dangerous. We are eager to tell their stories from different angles and styles, and in the process highlight the interesting and varied world of SCP. As mentioned on the Steam page, through the course of the game players will:
investigate a mysterious hydroelectric power plant,
immerse themselves in an uplifting fable, 
delve into a bizarre, retro-inspired world,
and much more besides!

All of these adventures are tied together through a framing narrative that has you take on the role of a rookie Foundation researcher. Are you ready to become the newest hire at Site-105?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/e83dcae89a75b54f6dfed95ff89a689f84324cba.jpg[/img]

Finally, let's talk about everyone's favorite plague doctor - SCP-049. You love him, we love him - apart from "the pestilence", everyone loves him! However, as we approach the launch of the game and the finished story comes into view, we've had to make a tough decision regarding 049. Originally slated to play a role in the main game, we'd decided to instead focus an entire section of DLC around this character. We want to do justice to SCP-049, and it became clear that this wouldn't be possible if we tried to incorporate him into the story as it now stands. Development of this DLC chapter will begin while the main game receives pre-launch polish, so you won't need to wait too long to see what we have planned!

Keep your eyes peeled for more updates soon...as well as one particularly big announcement that's coming in hot!

Over and out.

notes.title: May Devlog
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! GameZoo Studio here once more with a brand new update.
 
To kick things off, I would like to share the good news that we've just broken through 100,000 wishlists on Steam (cue applause)! Massive thanks to everyone who helped us reach this number.
 
We would also like to take this opportunity to discuss where we are in the development of SCP: Secret Files? How is the game progressing? When is it expected to launch? And what can we share regarding the plot of the game?
 
It has been more than three years since this project first started, yet actual development time probably totals just over a year. So what were we doing for the rest of that time? Well, to paraphrase a certain Foundation: 
 
[b]"We huddled in our small studio in front of workstations, fearful of the things we didn't understand: those hard-to-fix bugs, those rejected proposals, those warnings of "insufficient budget." These are the obstacles we were tasked with overcoming.
 
In time, the number of these obstacles dwindled and we become stronger. The direction of our project made more sense when there were fewer things to fear. Yet, development hurdles never truly go away, as if the industry demands the absurd and impossible.
 
But our studio cannot live in fear. No one else will protect us, and we must stand up for ourselves. While everyone else enjoys their holidays, we must carry the burden and move forward in order to finish our game as quickly as possible.
 
We aim to release on Steam, Console, and Phone."[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/60e93fc6e5091d853db4520d0b2c499c53b7e6ca.png[/img]

 
The Steam page for SCP: Secret Files officially launched on August 23, 2021. Over the following three months, as our game attracted players from all over the world, wishlists quickly grew to almost 30,000. However, at this point in time our game was less than 35% complete. Looking back, it was probably a mistake to launch our Steam page so early in development, and we're sorry to have made everyone wait so long.
 
Around October of last year, fuelled by player interest in our game, we pulled a few all-nighters in order to cobble together a working demo that could be used for presentation purposes. We are very grateful to everyone who participated in closed testing and provided valuable feedback (including one player who submitted four 20-page feedback documents!) Thank you for helping us to improve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/a06727ebbd7c77c5dcfb1bd68f9daecfc71e630a.png[/img]
 
In February of this year we gained access to a high-quality recording studio and a number of professional voice actors, and set about recording the English voice lines for our story about SCP-239. Most of the recording process went well, but we were yet to find a suitable actress capable of portraying the protagonist, who happens to be a little girl (after all, we don't want to be accused of illegal child labor!) Fortunately, one of our friends saved the day, and so this problem was eventually solved. This particular protagonist has a significant number of lines, and the performance requires quite a bit of intensity, so we can only assume that our little actress was close to losing her voice by the end of it all. The entire GZ staff salutes her!
 
 
SCP-239 Original Plot 
For our story involving SCP-239, we chose a point in time during the infancy of the anomaly (earlier than the official website setting). Following initial containment by the Foundation, Dr. Sean conducted a series of inhumane experiments on SCP-239. Another doctor, named Valette, believed that Sean's methods were unconscionable and decided to apply for the cultivation of anomalies by humanitarian means. However, is Valette's method really the correct course of action? And what is the fate of the anomaly?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/b4e0749c56b0c78b99d56b6bbf769c7fa84172c6.jpg[/img]

 
At the end of March, a friend from London asked if we would like to participate in the WASD offline exhibition, as this would enable fans to try out our demo. We jumped at the opportunity, packaged the first three chapters of our game (the most optimized at that time), and submitted them to the organizer. WASD was a great experience for us, with many players enjoying our game and others offering useful suggestions for how we might improve the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41083208/1043c6aa58c7f83bdef1953f89b2832cd6a99a2e.jpg[/img]
 
This all brings us to today, as we approach the end of May, 2022. SCP: Secret Files now stands at 70% completion, and the number of wishlists on Steam has just surpassed 100,000. We would like to express our heartfelt thanks for this. We hoped to have a demo available for everyone to try by April, but regrettably this has not been possible. However, we are now aiming to have a demo available in time for Steam Next Fest on June 13th! 
 
So, if you haven't already added the game to your wishlist, now's the perfect time!
